general.siteFullName: Emad Toranji Resume | Full-Stack Web Developer

home.summary-text: I am a full-stack developer with specialized experience in web-based systems engineering and implementation. My main focus is on creating beautiful user experiences and flawless performance using Next.js architecture and modern Tailwind CSS styling. I have the ability to implement secure authentication infrastructures with Next-Auth and manage complex databases to design a fully responsive, fast, and scalable product for your business.
experience-items: Design and implement web applications from scratch using Next.js to achieve the highest speed and best SEO.
Professional use of Tailwind CSS to develop fully responsive user interfaces (UI) that comply with the most modern design trends.
Implement comprehensive authentication systems with Next-Auth to securely manage user access levels.
Build high-speed Telegram mini-applications and integrate them with dedicated web services and payment gateways.
Design and normalize databases (SQL and PostgreSQL) for fast processing of large volumes of information.
Develop analytical dashboards with multilingual capabilities for international user use.

portfolio-items.title: Forex Trading Platform
portfolio-items.description: A responsive web application built as a Telegram mini-app, featuring user authentication, subscription management, and secure integration with web services. Supports Forex trading through a dedicated server infrastructure with a focus on security, stability, and high performance.

portfolio-items.title: Web Service Platform
portfolio-items.description: A responsive platform for providing and managing web services (APIs) for developers and businesses. Enables user registration, account balance management, secure API access, and service usage control. Built with a scalable architecture focused on security, transparent usage monitoring, and smooth user experience.

portfolio-items.title: Digital Menu Platform
portfolio-items.description: Design and development of a comprehensive platform for digitizing and managing store menus with a special focus on restaurants, cafes, fast food and food businesses. This system has been implemented with the aim of eliminating paper menus, improving customer experience and simplifying the content management process for business owners.

portfolio-items.title: Digital Currency Exchange
portfolio-items.description: Responsive web application in the form of a Telegram mini-app with the ability to authenticate users, deposit and withdraw digital currency, convert cryptocurrencies, and display the market view in real time.

portfolio-items.title: Corporate Website
portfolio-items.description: Design and implementation of a corporate website with a focus on brand identity, smooth user experience, and performance optimization, suitable for introducing services and increasing user interaction.

portfolio-items.title: Project Ad Registration and Management System
portfolio-items.description: Advanced Telegram bot for complete project ad management, including purchasing monthly subscriptions, automatic ad registration and review, online payment, publishing on channels, admin panel, and sending public messages.
